sources.processing: Natural Earth 10m v5.1.2 admin-1. South Africa's provinces, Lesotho and eSwatini, each dissolved to one shape, clipped, simplified to 500 m together with the basemap, coordinates rounded to 4 decimals. Lesotho and eSwatini from 1994-04-27. Provinces from 2006-03-01 (Twelfth Amendment, Proclamation R. 8 of 2006, Government Gazette 28568), low confidence until 2009-04-03 (Sixteenth Amendment, Proclamation R. 20 of 2009, Government Gazette 32091), when Merafong moved to Gauteng. Natural Earth's lines may predate those amendments in places.
sources.title: Natural Earth 10m admin-1 states and provinces

sources.author: Tom Patterson, Nathaniel Vaughn Kelso and contributors
sources.processing: Natural Earth 10m v4.1.0 admin-1 (2018-05-21). South Africa's nine provinces, each dissolved to one shape, clipped to the v5.1.2 outline of South Africa, simplified to 500 m together with the basemap, coordinates rounded to 4 decimals. Valid 1994-04-27 to 2006-03-01 (M1.3). Bushbuckridge is in Mpumalanga here, though it was in Northern Province until 2006. Natural Earth approximates the magisterial districts of Schedule 1 of the 1993 Constitution; low confidence.
sources.title: Natural Earth 10m admin-1 states and provinces, v4.1.0
